scope: VCS phase-local element ordering and charge/electron formula rows

implemented.element_order: Uses phase indexed element order; YAML declaration order is retained in the thermo phase and Solution element API
implemented.formula_matrix: Ports vcs_VolPhase::transferElementsFM elemental atom rows, electron charge row, electron-element deactivation under separate charge-neutrality constraint, and phase charge-neutrality row

limitations: The tests verify the translated phase-local matrix rules and API order; they do not establish VCS equilibrium solver parity.
VCS_SOLVE::solve_TP, basis optimization, species birth/death, and equilibrium convergence remain unported.
Full-suite success is regression evidence, not full Cantera equivalence.
